title: Customer Service Executive
description: Customer Service Executive Location: Crawley (Hybrid Working) Salary: Competitive + Excellent Benefits The Opportunity Are you passionate about delivering outstanding customer service? Do you enjoy helping customers, solving problems and making a real difference with every interaction? We're looking for Customer Service Executives to join a highly regarded organisation where you'll play a key role in supporting customers throughout their journey. This is an excellent opportunity to join a collaborative team environment with genuine opportunities for development and progression. The Role As a Customer Service Executive, you'll provide exceptional support to customers, ensuring every interaction is professional, helpful and tailored to individual needs. You'll handle a variety of enquiries across multiple communication channels while working closely with colleagues to deliver the highest levels of customer service and meet key service standards. Key responsibilities: - Handling customer enquiries via telephone, email, webchat and written correspondence. - Providing clear, accurate and professional information to customers. - Understanding customer needs and delivering tailored solutions. - Managing a wide range of customer requests and queries efficiently. - Working collaboratively with colleagues to achieve team and service objectives. - Ensuring all customer interactions are handled accurately and in line with regulatory and service standards. - Supporting continuous improvements to customer service processes. - Maintaining accurate records and documentation. - Contributing positively to team meetings and knowledge-sharing activities. About You We're looking for individuals who genuinely enjoy helping customers and take pride in delivering a first-class service. You'll ideally have: - Previous customer service experience within a regulated environment. - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. - The ability to explain complex information in a simple and easy-to-understand way. - A strong customer-focused mindset with a passion for delivering positive outcomes. - Excellent attention to detail and numerical accuracy. - The ability to remain calm and resilient in a fast-paced environment. - Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities. - A proactive and self-motivated approach to work. What's On Offer - Competitive salary. - Generous pension scheme. - Healthcare and wellbeing support. - Life assurance and income protection benefits. - Hybrid working arrangements. - Generous family-friendly policies. - Ongoing training, professional development and study support. - Additional wellbeing and lifestyle benefits. - Social events and employee engagement activities. - Clear opportunities for career progression within a growing organisation. Interested? If you're looking for a customer-focused role where you can build your career within a supportive and people-focused organisation, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to find out more. Reasonable Adjustments: Respect and equality are core values to us. We are proud of the diverse and inclusive community we have built, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and perspectives. Our success is driven by our people, united by the spirit of partnership to deliver the best resourcing solutions for our clients. If you need any help or adjustments during the recruitment process for any reason, please let us know when you apply or talk to the recruiters directly so we can support you.

title: Client Services Administrator
description: We are very pleased to be working exclusively alongside our professional, established and friendly client as they seek to recruit a Client Services Administrator to join their team on a full time permanent basis Client Services Administrator East Grinstead town centre area with parking available nearby / off site (approx £5 per day). 10-15 minute walk from East Grinstead station and bus routes. Full time permanent role - Monday - Thursday (Apply online only) with early finish at 1700 on Fridays. Office based role based in newly appointed very modern offices. £28000 per annum. 20 days holiday (rising to 25 with length of service) plus all UK bank holidays, good pension scheme, birthday leave as an extra day off plus great opportunities to learn and progress within the business. This is an excellent opportunity for a great team player who enjoys delivering outstanding service, managing documentation accurately, and supporting clients throughout important processes. Working closely with Consultants, senior stakeholders, and the wider operations team, you will play a key role in ensuring client records, documentation, and communications are managed efficiently while maintaining exceptional service standards. If you are detail-oriented, proactive, and passionate about providing first-class administrative support, we'd love to hear from you. The role - Client Services Administrator As a Client Services Administrator, you will support the day-to-day administration of client cases, ensuring documentation is prepared, processed, and maintained accurately. You'll be responsible for coordinating correspondence, supporting diary management, monitoring shared inboxes, and ensuring the smooth progression of client matters. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organisational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining confidentiality and professional standards. Duties and responsibilities include: - Maintain accurate client records, case notes, and administrative documentation. - Prepare professional correspondence and client documentation - Scan, file, archive, retrieve, and securely manage client records. - Track outstanding documents, signatures, and information requests. - Provide timely updates to clients regarding the progress of their cases. - Monitor shared inboxes and respond to routine enquiries - Coordinate diaries, appointments, meetings, and calendars. - Maintain stationery, office supplies, and departmental resources. - Handle confidential information in accordance with GDPR and company policies. - Assist with complaints administration, compliance processes, and data protection activities. Experience, skills and competencies required: Some office based experience in an administrative, client services, operations, or customer support role Excellent verbal and written communication skills High level of accuracy and attention to detail Confident using Microsoft Office 365, including Outlook, Word, and Excel Ability to manage confidential and sensitive information professionally Able to work independently and as part of a team For more information regarding this new and exciting Client Services Administrator opportunity, please apply now! Short-listing will take place soon - don't miss out! Berry Recruitment Services Ltd T/A First Recruitment Services is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy. Please note that no terminology in this advert is intended to discriminate on the grounds of a person's gender, marital status, race, religion, colour, age, disability or sexual orientation. Every candidate will be assessed only in accordance with their merits, qualifications and ability to perform the duties of the job

title: Customer Service Administrator

Salary: 28-32 K Location: Office based - Partridge Green. Own transport required due to location Hours: 8.30am-5.30pm Mon-Fri Customer Service Exec duties: - Act as the first point of contact for all incoming customer enquiries - Process customer information and qualify the call / order, what the customer is looking for etc. - Keep customers updated on what will happen next with their enquiry / order - Update the systems with the enquiry / order information - Maintain strong customer service and answer calls in a timely manner Skills and experience: - Proven experience working in a similar customer service - sales support type role ideally within the manufacturing, construction, or engineering sector - Highly organised and attention to detail - Good IT skills
